theorems.title: Smallest counterexample
theorems.conclusion: The smallest admissible even counterexample order is 32.

theorems.title: Infinite counterexample family
theorems.conclusion: The explicit family is a counterexample for every n=8L, L>=4.

theorems.title: Exact period-8 spectral edge
theorems.conclusion: The target squared radius is eta with a unique edge at z=1.

theorems.title: Period-8 structural optimum
theorems.conclusion: Among infinite-volume 8-periodic Hamilton-gauge phases, the target is the unique minimizer and the eight-barrier trichotomy holds.

theorems.title: General-period moment obstruction
theorems.conclusion: The first three moments and the two necessary eight-barrier conditions hold for every p>=1.

theorems.title: Low-period frontier
theorems.conclusion: The target is uniquely optimal among primitive tau periods at most 16.
